snippet.title: Into the Slimy Mines - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
A roguelike tower defense with a card-driven twist. Build your deck, carve out tunnels, and deploy defences directly into the path of the swarm. Rank up your chosen Guild and rescue your Dwarven crew to get off this frackin’ slime-infested moon!

Coming 29 May 2026 to PC, PS5, Series X|S and Nintendo Switch. 

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3639440/Into_the_Slimy_Mines/

Developed by Ant Workshop.
Published by Wales Interactive.
